The base rate cannot be computed: 30 awards, applicant count not published. On top of that, Stage 1 needs 23/30 points with per-criterion thresholds (8/10, 4/5, 8/10, 3/5) and TRL 7. Even with an assumed 10% base rate, 0.1 x 0.15 = about 1.5%.

verified.pArithmetic: Checked again on the AKINDO public API (the SPA page itself renders empty). The rules say 'the Mezo core team allocates points across eligible submissions. Each project's share of that Wave's pool is proportional to its share of total points.' No minimum score or cap is published. However, the core team decides the points, so a weak or off-scope entry could get zero; 'any eligible submission gets paid' is likely but not guaranteed. The re-fetch did not show the builder count (34 in the candidate), and the builder-to-product conversion figures from other AKINDO waves are not verified here. I treat both as unverified, and P does not depend on them because the pool is pro-rata. Recomputed: P(integration accepted as meaningful MUSD/MEZO utility, not a 'standalone app') ~0.65 x P(nonzero points given acceptance) ~0.8 x P(KYB passes for a Lithuanian MB or individual; Lithuania is not excluded) ~0.9 = ~0.47, rounded to 0.45. The candidate's 0.6 was optimistic because it assumed nonzero points automatically. Expected value is about $7,000 / ~30 = ~$230, or more if the entry scores well as an existing product. Both waves together give two chances.

P(ship) of 0.6 is plausible because the Phaser games already exist. The second factor (0.25 in the candidate) is invented. Token Tails has no Reddit audience, and 500 unique logged-in users acting in the app on a single day is a real growth milestone, not a formality. A more defensible guess is 0.10-0.15, giving 0.6 x 0.15 = 0.09 or lower. Reddit publishes no data on how many apps get paid. On top of that, eligibility for a Lithuanian payee is unverified, which could make P = 0. The candidate's 0.15 does not hold as sound arithmetic.

Real entries go through Discord, so the itch entry count means little. Free to enter, 16+ for prizes, no country limits stated. The page has no AI rule and no payout method. Joins may reach 80-120. The submit rate is assumed at 25-35%, giving about 20-40 entries. 3 placed prizes over that field is 7.5-15%, and the challenge pool adds 1-3 points, so P is about 0.11, borderline. EV = 0.11 x about $700 (average win) = about $77, or about $3.9 per human hour. Fit is medium-low: Anitya is a no-code 3D tool, not Phaser.
